content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

This is not a plugin or a SaaS tool. It’s a complete commerce stack—hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing—all assembled from free and paid components you control. The core principle is infrastructure sovereignty. Instead of renting platforms that exclude you, you own the stack. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets stores orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. No single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. This is how creators in financially isolated regions—Nigeria, Zimbabwe, Venezuela—build permanent commerce systems. It’s not a hack. It’s architecture. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this for you in 48 hours, configured, tested, and ready to sell. You own it after deployment. COREMERCH has no access. No subscriptions. No geographical blocks. Just your stack, your rules.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Start with hosting. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront—static HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Zero hosting fees. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are serverless functions that execute code on Cloudflare’s edge network. Apps Script is JavaScript that runs on Google’s infrastructure. Both are free tier-compatible. Orders are stored in Supabase (open-source Firebase alternative) or Google Sheets. Supabase offers SQL databases with auth and storage. Sheets is simpler but sufficient for small volumes. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Drive is familiar; R2 is object storage with CDN integration. Payments are processed via NOWPayments. Buyers pay in 300+ cryptocurrencies. NOWPayments verifies transactions on-chain and sends a webhook to your backend. The webhook triggers order storage and file delivery. No buyer account required. No KYC. 0.5% fee. Recommended networks: BSC, Solana, TRON—under $0.10 per transaction. The stack is modular. Swap components as needed. Upgrade storage, change payment networks, add email delivery—all without rebuilding from scratch. This is how infrastructure sovereignty works.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe, you know the problem. Stripe and PayPal exclude your country. Local processors charge exorbitant fees or fail at scale. You sell ebooks, courses, templates, beats, or software. Your product is global. Your payment options are not. This stack is your structural alternative. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. You don’t need permission to deploy it. You don’t depend on platforms that can cut you off. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for creators who value ownership over convenience. It’s deployed in 48 hours, configured for your products, and tested end-to-end. You get SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup for email delivery, 5 products loaded, and 30-day support. After deployment, it’s yours. No platform access. No subscriptions. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure means you own the stack. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free, fast, and globally distributed. Backend: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Workers are edge-computed; Apps Script is Google-backed. Order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Supabase is scalable; Sheets is simple. File delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Drive is ubiquitous; R2 is developer-friendly. Payments: NOWPayments. 300+ cryptocurrencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. The components integrate via APIs and webhooks. For example, when NOWPayments verifies a payment, it sends a webhook to your backend (Worker or Apps Script). The backend writes the order to Supabase or Sheets and triggers file delivery from Drive or R2. Email receipts are sent via configured SMTP with SPF/DKIM/DMARC. The stack is stateless. No customer data is stored on your servers. Files are delivered via signed URLs that expire. Security is built into every layer. This is how you sell digitally without depending on platforms that exclude you.

If you prefer DIY, buy the Sovereign Blueprint ($47). It includes complete docs, source code, and scaling guides. For full control, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes all blueprints and templates. Deployment requires no coding if you choose the Edge Stack. COREMERCH handles everything—hosting setup, backend configuration, payment integration, product loading, and email setup. You provide product files and payment details. After deployment, you own the stack. COREMERCH has no access. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure. Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is deployed for you in 48 hours. No coding required. You own the stack after deployment.
